title: Snap your plate.
intro: NUSI identifies the food, the Nutrition Engine looks up the exact values from IFCT 2017. Every number is traceable.

capture.analyzingTitle: NUSI is looking at your plate

provenance.note: Calories and macros computed by the Nutrition Engine using authoritative database values. Every item has an audit trail.

detected.heading: Detected items
detected.unresolved: Couldn't match to a database food - tap to clarify

log.logNote: Logging re-checks every food against the database and saves a traceable nutrition snapshot your nutritionist can review.

tips.heading: Tips for a good photo
tips.topDown: Shoot top-down so every item is visible.
tips.light: Good, even light - avoid harsh shadows.
tips.onePlate: One plate per photo gives the cleanest read.
tips.fillFrame: Fill the frame; keep the whole meal in view.

how.heading: How the numbers are made
how.step1: Gemini identifies foods, portions, and cooking method - no guessed numbers.
how.step2: The Nutrition Engine looks up each food in IFCT 2017 / USDA.
how.step3: Anything it can't match confidently is flagged for review - never fabricated.
how.auditFooter: Every logged item keeps a traceable audit trail.
